Perfect! All 40 tests pass. 

**The root cause:** The pricing engine was rounding prematurely after each discount calculation. When a percent coupon was applied, the result was rounded to 2 decimals, then that rounded value was used for the flat discount calculation. This caused compounding rounding errors — exactly the off-by-a-cent issues Finance flagged.

**The fix:** Removed the intermediate `round()` calls after the percent and flat discount operations (lines 24 and 27). Now all discounts are stacked in full precision, and rounding happens only once at the very end after converting to the target currency. This matches the reference implementation and eliminates the precision loss.

The fix is especially critical for stacked coupons (SAVE10PCT + FLAT5) across all currencies including JPY (zero-decimal), which all now pass correctly.
